chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:

We sent a message to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and we were a group, and we were in Al-Medina, saying, 'We intend to bid you farewell.' So he sent a message to us: 'Wash yourselves in Al-Medina, for I am afraid that finding water would be difficult for you in Dhi al-Hulayfa. Therefore, wash in Al-Medina, and wear the clothes in which you will enter the state of Ihram, then come individually or in twos.'

key_terms.ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ: Dhi al-Hulayfa (the traditional Miqat for residents of Al-Medina)

ai.seo_question: Where should one perform Ghusl for Ihram when leaving Al-Medina according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the practical flexibility (rukhsah) in Shia jurisprudence regarding the location of Ghusl for Ihram, prioritizing ease of access to water over strict adherence to the specific Miqat boundary when necessary. It underscores the Imam’s attention to the physical conditions of the pilgrims, instructing them to perform the bath in Medina and don their garments before presenting themselves individually or in small groups, thereby emphasizing both ritual purity and orderly conduct in the presence of the Imam.
